 4                 I ask everyone to please rise and

10    silent reflection or prayer.

11                 (Whereupon, the assemblage respected

16    January 6, 2026, the Senate met pursuant to 

17    adjournment.  The Journal of Monday, January 5, 

18    2026, was read and approved.  On motion, the 

19    Senate adjourned.

20                 THE PRESIDENT:   Without objection, 

21    the Journal stands approved as read.

 7    Mr. President --

10    colleagues.  

11                 Mr. President, there's a resolution 

12    at the desk.  I ask that that resolution be read 

13    in its entirety, and I move for its immediate 

14    adoption.

16    substitution at the desk.

23    so ordered.

 1    823, by Assemblymember Peoples-Stokes, Concurrent 

 2    Resolution of the Senate and Assembly relative to 

 3    the adjournment sine die of the 2025 Session of 

 4    the Legislature.  

 5                 THE PRESIDENT:   The question is on 

 6    the resolution.  All those in favor please 

 7    signify by saying aye.

 8                 (Response of "Aye.")

 9                 THE PRESIDENT:   Opposed, nay.

10                 (No response.)

11                 THE PRESIDENT:   The resolution is 

12    adopted.

13                 The 2025 Legislative Session is 

14    adjourned sine die.  

15                 (Whereupon, at 12:36 p.m., the 

16    Senate adjourned.)
